title: AADP Relations Module v1.0 — Module schema dispatch
description: The schema URL a manifest's `modules[]` entry points at (specification.md §2, §10). Dispatches by `kind` to exactly the three top-level Relations document schemas — `relation-set`, `relation-collection`, `relation-registry`. This schema MUST NOT be used to validate the manifest discovery entry `{id, version, schema}` itself, which is validated by the core manifest schema v1.0 (ADR-0007 'Module ID and discovery'); component schemas (relation-item, target, collection-link) are not registered as document kinds here.
